comment: Membrane-associated glycosyltransferase that transfers β-D-glucose from UDP-D-glucose to the C-24 hydroxyl of one α-L-vancosamine moiety of antarmycin C, yielding antarmycin A.

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 replaced reaction SMILES with reaction SMARTS

reactions.description: Transfer of β-D-glucose to the C-24 hydroxyl of one α-L-vancosamine moiety of antarmycin C, yielding antarmycin A
Glucosylation of antarmycin C (3) to yield antarmycin A (1), validated by in vitro microsomal fraction assay using UDP-D-glucose as sugar donor.
